Package nl.pim16aap2.lightkeeper.framework

Record Class EntitySnapshot

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
nl.pim16aap2.lightkeeper.framework.EntitySnapshot
Record Components:
uuid - The entity's UUID.
typeKey - Namespaced entity type key, e.g. minecraft:block_display.
position - The entity's position at the burst tick.
customName - The entity's custom name, or null when unnamed.
pdcKeys - Namespaced keys present in the entity's persistent data container, sorted.
transform - The display transformation for display entities, or null for all other entities.
tick - The server tick of the query burst.
public record EntitySnapshot(UUID uuid, String typeKey, Vec3 position, @Nullable String customName, List<String> pdcKeys, @Nullable EntitySnapshot.Transform transform, long tick) extends Record
Frozen snapshot of one entity's state, read in the same main-thread burst as its query siblings — every snapshot from one EntityQuery.snapshot() call shares one tick and is internally consistent.
